title: A clean cancellation
transcript:
Customer: I want to cancel before the next billing date.
Agent: Understood. I can cancel your renewal now.
Customer: Will access continue until the end of the month?
Agent: Yes. Renewal is now disabled, and access continues until your current period ends.
Customer: I see it marked cancelled in my account.

key_points: Renewal disabled and customer confirmed the account status.
expected.resolution_details: Renewal disabled and customer confirmed the account status.
